info.title: blazix — copy Blazix components into your Blazor project as source you own.
info.description: Copies Blazix's styled Blazor components into your project as source you own.

commands.name: accordion
commands.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

commands.name: alert
commands.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

commands.name: alert-dialog
commands.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

commands.name: aspect-ratio
commands.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

commands.name: attachment
commands.description: A file attached to a message or an upload, with its state and actions.

commands.name: avatar
commands.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

commands.name: badge
commands.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge.

commands.name: breadcrumb
commands.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

commands.name: bubble
commands.description: A chat bubble for a message.

commands.name: button
commands.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

commands.name: button-group
commands.description: A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.

commands.name: calendar
commands.description: A date grid for choosing a day.

commands.name: card
commands.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

commands.name: carousel
commands.description: A carousel with motion and swipe built using Embla.

commands.name: checkbox
commands.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

commands.name: code-block
commands.description: Displays code, with a header, actions and line numbers.

commands.name: collapsible
commands.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel.

commands.name: combobox
commands.description: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

commands.name: command
commands.description: A searchable list of actions or options.

commands.name: context-menu
commands.description: Displays a menu to the user, triggered by a right click.

commands.name: dialog
commands.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window.

commands.name: direction
commands.description: Sets the reading direction for the components inside.

commands.name: drawer
commands.description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen and can be swiped away.

commands.name: dropdown-menu
commands.description: Displays a menu to the user, such as a set of actions or functions, triggered by a button.

commands.name: empty
commands.description: Use the Empty component to display an empty state.

commands.name: field
commands.description: Combine labels, controls, and help text to compose accessible form fields.

commands.name: hover-card
commands.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

commands.name: input
commands.description: Displays a form input field or a component that looks like an input field.

commands.name: input-group
commands.description: Add addons, buttons, and helper content to inputs.

commands.name: input-otp
commands.description: Accessible one-time password component with copy-paste functionality.

commands.name: item
commands.description: A versatile component that you can use to display any content.

commands.name: kbd
commands.description: Used to display textual user input from keyboard.

commands.name: label
commands.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

commands.name: marker
commands.description: A note in a conversation, like a date or an event.

commands.name: menubar
commands.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications.

commands.name: message
commands.description: A message in a conversation, with an avatar, header and footer.
